value.rationale: Under uniform random inputs, the complete most-likely and runner-up output ranking is a natural nontrivial invariant of an iconic chaotic cellular automaton. A sharp all-length nonzero mode and complete equality pattern improve on a known homogeneous zero count and offer explicit benchmarks for inverse inference and image probabilities, without relying on an arbitrary parameter slice.
